gaps.quote: The bit procedure, which interchanges two equal address chunks on tape using a fixed bit network
gaps.note: The bit procedure and its fixed bit network are a named construction that the page neither explains nor links to another page. The cited claim about its endpoint operator therefore has no referent the reader can identify.

gaps.quote: Each triangular step costs linear time, because each field is updated from earlier fields in descending order and so still holds its original value.
gaps.note: The page gives the order of the updates but not the size or sparsity of E_1 and E_2. A dense lower-triangular matrix applied to a vector takes about n^2 multiplications, so linear cost does not follow from what the page gives.
